title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 79 (Application of charge provisions to other events)

content.overview: The section 77 charge-registration provisions apply, so far as may be, when a company acquires property already subject to a charge or when the terms, conditions, extent or operation of a registered charge are modified.
content.glance: The section 77 charge-registration provisions apply, so far as may be, when a company acquires property already subject to a charge or when the terms, conditions, extent or operation of a registered charge are modified.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 79 (Application of section 77 to certain charges). The provisions of section 77 relating to registration of charges apply, so far as may be, to (a) a company acquiring any property subject to a charge within the meaning of section 77, and (b) any modification in the terms or conditions, extent or operation of a charge registered under section 77. Section 79 applies the section 77 registration framework to these events; it does not create a separate registration system. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Acquisition of charged property
sections.body: Where a company acquires property already subject to a charge within the meaning of section 77, the section 77 charge-registration provisions apply so far as may be.

sections.heading: Modification of registered charge
sections.body: The section 77 provisions also apply, so far as may be, to modifications in the terms or conditions, extent or operation of a charge registered under section 77.
